## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A five-fascicle commentary on [KR6n0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0016) *Chéng wéishí lùn* by the late-seventh- or eighth-century Cí'ēn commentator [道邑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E9%82%91) (Dàoyì). Preserved in the *Xuzangjing* (X49n0814). The "*yìyùn*" 義蘊 ("doctrinal substance / interior meaning") title indicates a substantive doctrinal commentary that goes beyond glossary into systematic exposition of the philosophical implications of T1585.

**Abstract**

The text is one of several second-tier Cí'ēn commentaries on T1585 that survive only through the *Xuzangjing* and not the Taishō. Internal evidence suggests Dàoyì draws systematically on [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA)'s [KR6n0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0026) *shùjì* but apparently not on [智周](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%91%A8)'s [KR6n0032](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0032) *yǎnmì*; the work is therefore conventionally placed in the late seventh or early eighth century, perhaps roughly contemporary with [慧沼](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%B2%BC). The dating bracket adopted (700–800) reflects this uncertainty.

The commentary is doctrinally orthodox-Cí'ēn but distinguishes itself by spending more time than Kuījī's *shùjì* on the *yīnmíng* 因明 (Buddhist logic / *hetuvidyā*) implications of the *Chéng wéishí lùn* arguments — possibly reflecting Dàoyì's institutional location in a Cí'ēn-affiliated *yīnmíng* lecture-tradition.
